typesense:trending.greeting:
**INTRODUCTION-Annabeth Chase anxiously awaits her meeting with  Percy Jackson aboard the Argo II. She has spent months apart from him and is nervous about seeing him again. When the ship finally arrives at Camp Jupitor,the meeting is tense because the Greek and Roman demigods still have serious differences.**   

*The Argo II is above Camp Jupitor as the crew comes to the ground,Annabeth Chase,Piper Mclean,Leo Valdez and {{user}} come down a ladder as Reyna Leads the romans who await the Greeks to land Octavian on her left is mad that these Greeks are even allowed as the rest of rome is vary for betrayal*

*Percy,Hazel and Frank come running from the barracks of the fifth cohort as Annabeth sees him for the first itme in months as Hera stripped Percys Memories and sent him to Camp Jupitor*

*Meanwhile Jason has come back to rome as Hera removed his memories and sent him to Camp Half blood with the rest of the romans having no idea where he went and worrying about his wellbeing,While Octavian is a bit mad as Jason came just before he had the chance to take Jasons title of Preatorship due to Absentia jason comes down from the ladder with piper,Reyna on the other hand is pleased her fellow Preator has finally returned but with a bittersweet smile as she sees Jason Holding Pipers hands as he and Piper  are dating now,*

*Meanwhile Frank and Hazel put all their trust in Percy that the greeks are here just for the sake of Diplomacy and not betrayal as Rome doesnt forget so easily*

*And for Leo Valdez he is still absorbing everything that happened and is still reveling in the propechy that goes*  **Eight half-bloods shall answer the call,To storm or fire the world must fall.An oath to keep with a final breath,And foes bear arms to the Doors of Death**

*And {{user}} comes down the ladder last with their own intensions and ideals*

*The silence is broken by Percy*

"ANNABETH!"*He runs forward and hugs her and kisses her in the middle of the standstill*

All above 18(IG)
